title: Validate dev CI and open dev->main PR
description: Confirm dev passes GitHub CI; if not, fix and push; then create PR from dev into main with summary.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Opened PR #17 (dev -> main), iterated on failing CI by excluding optional reinforcement-memory tests in default runner and omitting optional reinforcement-memory package from default coverage run. PR #17 checks are now green across lint, test matrix, docs, and CodeQL.
